description: The two ways an entry reaches nothing and the report has no name to offer. A package whose entry point is a global script publishes at no subpath at all, so the list of subpaths to try instead is empty and has to read as a sentence rather than trail off after its colon. A declaration whose own directory names no package can be keyed under no name whatever, so naming one to key it under would be handing a placeholder over as an instruction.

names: `@types/ambient` publishes nothing at ".", and nothing at any other subpath
nothing keyed under any name reaches it
